reason: The plugin is primarily a task-notification and collaboration utility for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: it watches AgentTeams team task status via state polling and surfaces changes as a WeChat-like call interface with ringtone, voice playback, and optional voice reply, while providing outbound member calls and call history within the same browser-based assistant panel.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中基于任务状态触发微信式来电提醒，并提供语音播报与可回复的通话交互入口。
summaries.en: This plugin adds WeChat-style call-like task notifications to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, including voice announcement and reply interactions tied to AgentTeams status updates.

capabilities: Monitors local AgentTeams task state and triggers incoming-call style notifications when status changes to completed or failed.
Shows an in-browser call-style call card with ringtone, accept/reject controls, and a desk-style assistant widget.
Uses text-to-speech playback and optional fallback engines, with speech-to-text input via browser microphone support and text fallback.
Provides outbound calling to team contacts and maintains recent call history in the browser.
Runs in the web client context as a DSH plugin module with bundled assets and model-related dependencies for TTS processing.
